description: Fourth slice. Replace stringly protocol-impl-target classification (World::module_impl_target_ty classifying by last-segment strings + module_struct_fields) with a typed classification backed by facts: builtin value family vs Struct(ModuleId) vs non-struct nominal; module_impl_target_ty projects from that typed kind to Ty. Also migrate jobs/semantic.rs struct_assertion_ty. Test (ticket #5): defimpl P, for: A does not classify A by string; if A is a struct, impl-target type carries nominal identity + tuple/map field evidence via the typed struct-target path. Needs the StructDef store from the first slice.

comments.text: Folded at 01c54cd81 (clean cherry-pick). Introduced typed ImplTargetKind {Struct(module), Builtin(BuiltinValueFamily: List/Integer/Float/Atom/Binary/Map), Nominal}; classify_impl_target checks struct_def FIRST (fixing the real bug: old code matched the last name segment against the builtin list BEFORE checking struct-ness, so a struct named ...List was misclassified as the builtin list). Deleted the stringly free fn impl_target_ty; module_impl_target_ty projects the kind to Ty; struct_assertion_ty migrated to the StructDef store. Adversarial audit confirmed builtin-family set byte-identical to old, Nominal fallback identical, test non-vacuous, scope-clean (no .10/.11/.13 leak), commit stash-clean. ONE MUST-FIX caught + fixed at fold: classify_impl_target only subscribed to StructDefined when the struct was ALREADY defined -> a forward-referenced struct impl target classified Nominal/Builtin with no wake path, permanently mis-typed. Fixed: reads.push(StructDefined(module)) UNCONDITIONALLY before the branch (mirrors the ProtocolImplProviders idiom; non-blocking reads-subscription re-wakes to reclassify struct-first when StructDefined lands, without hanging on bare names). Added out-of-order regression test (any-receiver + identity fn so main's return is the impl-target shape; empty vs non-empty intersect across two drives proves the re-wake), verified non-vacuous by in-place revert (no git stash). lib 1255/0/6, matrix 350/11, clippy+fmt clean.

title: Structs: typed protocol-impl-target classification backed by facts
